description: Harness-agnostic hook wiring: event -> handler script. Handlers read a JSON event on stdin, write messages to stderr, and exit 0 (allow) or 2 (block). sync-harnesses.js translates this file into each harness's native hook configuration.

hooks.description: Block writes to approved reference assets (immutable; supersede with a new version).
Validate schema-known production/ artifacts after every write.
Warn when a shot's axis/screen direction/wardrobe drifts from scene-state.
Block generate-assets --live without an explicit --yes confirmation.
